requirements: The allocation size argument must be representable as the size type accepted by pvPortMalloc without wrapping.

rules.expression: pucQueueStorage = ( uint8_t * ) pxNewQueue; pucQueueStorage += sizeof( Queue_t )
requirements: pxNewQueue must designate a live allocated object of at least sizeof(Queue_t) bytes so that forming the interior byte pointer at offset sizeof(Queue_t) remains within or one past the allocated object.
pxNewQueue must designate a live allocated Queue_t object that is writable for the ucStaticallyAllocated member.

rules.expression: prvInitialiseNewQueue( uxQueueLength, uxItemSize, pucQueueStorage, ucQueueType, pxNewQueue )
requirements: pxNewQueue must designate a live allocated Queue_t object that prvInitialiseNewQueue may access according to its contract.
pucQueueStorage must designate a readable and writable storage region of at least uxQueueLength * uxItemSize bytes for the queue storage.
